These files are closely related to the bug scenario:
- lib/features/modeling/behavior/DropOnFlowBehavior.js: Handles logic for dropping elements on existing flows (in this case, dropping an event onto a sequence flow). The bug is likely rooted here, since dropping the event triggers the logic that may incorrectly remove sequenceFlow properties.
- lib/features/modeling/Modeling.js: Central module orchestrating element replacement, including sequence flow manipulations when elements are dropped. It may call or configure behavior that leads to the removal of conditionExpression.
- lib/features/modeling/cmd/UpdatePropertiesHandler.js: Handles updating properties on BPMN elements. If conditionExpression is being deleted, it likely happens through property updates executed here.
- lib/features/replace/BpmnReplace.js: Contains logic for replacing BPMN elements. Swapping a flow element for a timer event may trigger this code and associated logic related to sequence flow properties.

These files together govern the drop, replacement, and update logic central to the bug, and code changes to preserve conditionExpression (unless truly needed) would likely be made here.
